scope: Offline two-case retained-face residual experiment only. No Rust, runtime, package record, authority, factorization, active-set, tolerance, or physical-model change.

candidate_path.arithmetic: IEEE-754 binary64 scalar operations only; no FMA, sum, math.fsum, BLAS, Decimal, Fraction, sort, reassociation, or precision selection.
candidate_path.row_input: x=[f_i,A_i0,A_i1,...,A_i20]; y=[1.0,p_0,p_1,...,p_20] in this order for every i=0..20.
candidate_path.grouping: [p,s]=TwoProduct(x0,y0); for i=1..21: [h,r]=TwoProduct(xi,yi); [p,q]=TwoSum(p,h); s=fl(s+fl(q+r)); result=fl(p+s). This is ORO (2005) Algorithm 5.3 / equivalent 5.4 grouping.
candidate_path.residual_position: Run the accepted ordinary ordered-binary64 correction 1 first and require all its delta and p bits to equal the accepted audit. At that p only, form each second residual row with Dot2; apply the same accepted factor-reuse lambda_step once, updating free coordinates in ascending recorded free-id order. Active coordinates remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
candidate_path.prohibited_after_result: No extra correction, residual algorithm, factorization, face, lambda, clipping, normalization, post-result constant search, or altered predicate. A numerical failure stops the prototype.

primitive_controls.admission: Every input and every recorded intermediate must be finite and either normal or signed zero. Any nonzero subnormal, nonfinite value, splitter overflow, nonzero-product underflow, or failed error-free identity is PROTOTYPE_LIMITATION.
primitive_controls.exact_identity_controls_outside_candidat: For every TwoSum verify Fraction(a)+Fraction(b)==Fraction(x)+Fraction(y); for Split verify Fraction(a)==Fraction(hi)+Fraction(lo); for admitted TwoProduct verify Fraction(a)*Fraction(b)==Fraction(product)+Fraction(error). These controls are diagnostics only and never feed candidate arithmetic.
primitive_controls.range_and_cost: Record operand/intermediate signed-bit extrema and actual arithmetic, guard, branch, exceptional-branch, primitive-call and identity-control counts. The paper reference is 25*n-7=543 arithmetic operations per 22-term row and 11403 across 21 rows before guards.

required_result_assessments.residual: For each of 21 rows at correction-1 p, retain Dot2 bits, recreated historical Decimal-200-rounded residual bits, exact Fraction residual, signed errors, and correctly rounded exact-reference bit/ULP correspondence where defined.
required_result_assessments.second_correction: Report factor-reuse delta bits, final p bits, active preservation, unchanged guarded BVLS-02 h/Cbar/tau/classes, all original scaled box bounds, radius-1 ball, and exact-reference p error for every coordinate.
required_result_assessments.cost: Report residual formation, reused factor corrections, free-coordinate updates, unchanged KKT/enclosure assessment, and one-time reconstruction separately. Do not claim timing or runtime speedup.

pre_run_checks: Python AST compilation of dot2 source
static source guard that candidate functions contain neither Decimal nor Fraction nor math.fsum nor sum nor fma
independent review of grouping, guard treatment, accepted-audit bit controls, and result schema before the two-case calculation
release_rule: The author must not execute the result-bearing two-case prototype until Astra records explicit release after independent pre-run review.
